1. **2D class averages (3×3 montage):** 9 class averages, all roughly elliptical/oval particles viewed at various tilted orientations — no clear top-down axis view with symmetry; no elongated detergent micelle belt/halo distinguishable around cores (particles look compact, smeared). No black/empty placeholder frames — all 9 filled.

2. **J9 ab-initio class 1 (grey):** Oblique/side-ish view of a blobby, low-res globular map with holes; no detergent micelle belt/ring visible; not a clean axis-aligned standard view. Not a placeholder.

3. **J9 ab-initio class 2 (yellow):** Roughly spherical blob, slightly oblique view; no micelle belt; no obvious axis-aligned orientation. Not a placeholder.

4. **J9 ab-initio class 3 (cyan):** Elongated/oblique view, fragmented low-res density; no micelle belt; not axis-aligned. Not a placeholder.

5. **J48 class 1 (grey):** Top-down (axis) view — roughly circular, granular high-resolution-looking density spread evenly, consistent with viewing down a symmetry axis; no micelle ring (map shown at high threshold); reads as a standard axis-aligned view. Not a placeholder.

6. **J48 class 2 (yellow):** Also top-down axis view, similar circular granular map, slightly looser/noisier with stray densities at edges; no micelle belt. Not a placeholder.

7. **J48 class 3 (cyan):** Fragmented/disconnected density pieces — poor/failed class, appears to be junk or over-sharpened noise rather than a coherent protein; no micelle belt; no meaningful orientation. Not blank, but effectively a junk/placeholder-quality frame.

8. **Final refined map J55 (grey):** Oblique/side view of a resolved, dimer-like two-lobed map with defined helical/rod-like densities; no detergent micelle belt/ring visible at this threshold; orientation looks like a standard side-on view of the assembly (not top-down). Not a placeholder.
